## [Overview](https://security.bitly.com/?itemName=overview&itemUid=8f4661bb-7741-49e8-93c9-f7c9ee4d487b&source=click)

Bitly is committed to protecting your data and earning your trust every day. As part of that commitment, we’ve achieved SOC 2 compliance—demonstrating our dedication to the security, availability, and confidentiality of our systems.

You can view and request access to our audit report and security documentation through this portal. Once approved, you’ll receive a secure email with access details.
